## What it is

A flat C-clip that snaps sideways into the cradle locking pin. Print one plus at least one spare.

## Design notes

The 4.7 mm inner opening runs freely around the pin's 4.4 mm groove. Its 4.2 mm entrance flexes open by 0.2 mm per side during insertion and then closes behind the neck. The opposite thumb tab has a deep structural overlap with the ring and makes removal possible without tools. Print flat as modelled; PETG is preferred for repeated flexing, though PLA should work for occasional assembly.

## Don't

Do not scale the clip in the slicer because that changes both retention and groove fit. Do not force a visibly cracked clip back into service; print the included spare.
